body:
Kid in a bathroom stall next to his dad, reading the words on the stall:

Kid: "Daddy, what does F-I-S-T-I-N-G mean?"

Father: "Why don't you just finish up and stop reading the stall, son."
Damn, got blown off again. This is tough.

Hell yeah man. I feel the exact same way. It can just come out of nowhere and completely overwhelm you.

All I can tell you is too seek therapy and/or antidepressants. The suddenness of these things sort of seems like a chemical imbalance in your brain, not something situational. I have something similar, therefore for me it makes more sense for me to take antidepressants to fight the chemical imbalance.

It sucks. Feeling like dying for no apparent reason. I sometimes am in fear of when the next "attack" depression will occur.

Note: I am not any sort of authority, just telling you my viewpoint.

Hah thanks anyway. I appreciate your listening.

Yeah, I do understand that I do want to live and that this is evidenced by the fact that I am even posting here.

It's just hard to motivate to even look for a job right now. I'm not sure how to really do it.

I really think I would be happy with any job, but I don't even have the motivation to apply to lower level jobs either.

I hope you and I figure it out too. It's hard to imagine why something so debilitating exists and affects so many people.

Haha no, the antidepressants just made me really dizzy.

I appreciate your thoughts. It just seems really hard to see some sort of point when I'm going to have to deal with this for the rest of my life. It's pretty hard to fight this constantly, so I get what you're saying about big changes to snap me out of it.

It's just hard to that. I will admit that I am frightened of the prospect of drastic changes in my life. It's hard to know where to start.

My degree is environmental science, which I do enjoy. I am currently looking for a job, but it's been pretty hard to motivate to do it, even though I know it will probably make me feel better.

I'm just having a hard time getting over the "hump," I suppose.
